description: Na₄Al₃Si₃O₁₂I crystallizes in the cubic P̅43n space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O and one I atom. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.38 Å. The Na-I bond length is 3.15 Å. Al is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.76 Å. Si is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.64 Å. O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. I is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent Na atoms.
